evidence.detail: Release package archive 74,530,183 bytes, SHA-256 7e1aab4e85ca1736238db3cbdc829af3ec59fbbe56aae2ccf8e0dd37a13fe7ae; staged SHA256SUMS covers regular payload files. Stage uses GNU13.3.0, Qt6.12, Ubuntu24.04/glibc2.39 and bundled pinned mpv; optional native/model inspection is off. Package hashes and `$ORIGIN` recipe do not close licensing: member crosswalk, apt/source closure, mutable libass, Qt relink/source delivery and exact dependency source/license inputs remain unresolved. Linux readiness remains false.

Recipe identifies Ubuntu22.04 baseline, Wayland1.23.1/protocols1.41, FFmpeg n9.0.2 with GPL+version3, shaderc v2024.0 (git-sync dependencies), Vulkan SDK1.3.296.0, libplacebo v7.360.1 plus inline swapchain source edit, mutable libass master, and mpv libmpv/CUDA/Vulkan/Lua. These are workflow candidate inputs, not proof of exact stage revisions or per-library licenses.

When MIKAI_LINUX_BUNDLE_MPV=ON, the pinned archive is SHA-256 checked and owned shared libraries are placed under the executable-local mpv/ directory (install tree: ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}/mpv; build tree: target executable directory/mpv). patchelf is build-only and required; RUNPATH is set to $ORIGIN on packaged owned libraries, so final payload hashes differ from original archive/member hashes. Archive SHA and post-patchelf installed-file hashes must remain distinct. No global LD_LIBRARY_PATH is used. Host glibc/loader, graphics stack and GPU drivers remain external. This is source/configuration evidence, not final artifact or runtime proof.
